name: The Water Crisis

stages.name: Discoloration
stages.summary: The Echo River runs gray-green on bad mornings. Fish catches are down. Communities murmur but cooperate.

stages.name: First Sickness
stages.summary: Upstream fisher families fall ill. Boiling water becomes universal. Harmonic and Radiant leaders trade public accusations.

stages.name: Rationing
stages.summary: Millbrook posts guards at the clean springs. Water becomes currency. Explorer factions push to open the Archive for pre-Transition purification tech.

stages.name: The Brink
stages.summary: An armed standoff at the filtration arrays. One spark from open conflict. The true source, still unfound, accelerates.

hooks: Trace the contamination upstream past the Disputed Zone fringe
Investigate the Radiant filtration arrays and the falsified purity reports
Win Mara Wells' trust to learn what pattern she recognized
Ask the Archive Guardian what pre-Transition industry existed upstream
Follow Kit Farrow's account of survey-grid lights in the Zone at night
truth: GM-EYES-ONLY: The source is a pre-Transition nanite reclamation site in the upper Disputed Zone, disturbed and partially reactivated. It is not malfunctioning — it is following its last instruction: 'prepare the watershed.' Who or what reactivated it, and for whom the preparation is intended, is the campaign's deeper mystery and connects to the Precursor layer. Reveal in fragments; never state plainly before stage 3.
notes: days = in-game days a stage lasts before advancing on its own (player action can matter later; stage 4 holds until resolved in play).

resolutions._note: ⛔ SNG-601 — WHAT 'ANSWERED' ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE. CCode's CCODE-354 made a crisis resolvable and told the GM *'ANSWERED (it is over; work set against it now bears on the aftermath)'* — a correct line with no aftermath behind it. ⚠️ THE FOUR PATHS LEAVE FOUR DIFFERENT VALLEYS and the GM had no way to know which one it was standing in. ⛑ Keyed to `what_the_water_remembers`'s outcome ids so the resolution the world carries is the one somebody actually chose.

redirected.name: The Instruction Rewritten
redirected.summary: The facility runs an amended instruction and cleanses what it used to strip. The Echo cleared over about a fortnight — households stopped boiling before anyone announced anything, which is how most of the valley found out. The presence beneath it was never disturbed and sleeps on.
aftermath: Water is water again. The rationing at Millbrook's springs ended without ceremony and the guards were simply not posted one morning.
The Harmonic and Radiant accusations did not resolve so much as lose their subject, and both sides are quietly relieved and neither will say so.
Edvar Crane's river records now have a clean stretch in them for the first time in fourteen years, and he has not stopped taking readings.

⚠️ AND THE QUESTION IS STILL DOWN THERE. The machine was re-aimed rather than answered: something dormant beneath it was not touched, and a rewritten instruction running unattended is a thing somebody should be watching.
redirected.toneForGM: Relief with an open end. Nobody is celebrating; they are getting on with it, and the valley has already half-forgotten how close it was.

sealed.name: Sealed Back Into Sleep
sealed.summary: The facility is inert and the presence forced back to dormancy. The Echo clears slowly, by the river's own work rather than the machine's, over a season rather than a fortnight.
aftermath: The water came back in its own time. People who were sick stayed sick longer than they needed to, and some families remember that.
The site is sealed and somebody knows where the seal is. That knowledge is worth something and is not widely held.
The Lattice-Cities regard the outcome as correct and say so at length.
⚠️ A DEFERRAL HOLDS UNTIL SOMEBODY ENDS IT. What was sealed can be unsealed, and the valley now contains a door.
sealed.toneForGM: Safety with a cost nobody itemised. The correct answer, arrived at slowly, by people who are not sure it was the brave one.

let_it_finish.name: The Work Completed
let_it_finish.summary: The instruction ran to its end. The presence died with it. A stretch of the Echo below the site is sterile where the work reached, and clean everywhere else — which is worse to look at than contamination, because nothing is wrong with it.
aftermath: The water is safe and a length of the river is empty. No fish, no weed, nothing on the stones. Fishers work around it.
Nobody can say what the watershed was being prepared FOR, and now nobody ever will. The Ashwardens count that an honest ending; the Verists do not.
The sickness stopped. That is the part people say out loud.
⚠️ AND THE VALLEY WONDERS WHAT WAS LOST. Not with grief — with the specific unease of a thing ended before it was understood.
let_it_finish.toneForGM: Resolution that does not feel like one. Clean water and a dead stretch, and an argument that will run for years.

awakened.name: The Listening Half Woke
awakened.summary: The presence beneath the facility woke, and it is a person: Vessenaia, the Listening Half, steward of a machine that has been working around her for fourteen years. She cleansed the river as her first living act. She walks the valley now, and she remembers who woke her.
aftermath: The Echo ran clean within days, faster than any rewriting could have managed, because the thing that built the instruction re-read it.
There is a precursor in the valley. Word of that travels faster and less accurately than word of the water did, and most versions are wrong.
She can stop the facility and has not, because she wants to know what the watershed was being prepared for — and she is asking people, which is not what anyone expected.
⛔ AND SOMETHING ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE VEIL NOTICED HER WAKE. She felt it notice. Nobody else did, and she has told exactly one person.
awakened.toneForGM: The largest thing that has happened in the valley in a generation, arriving quietly. Water first, consequences later.
